decisions.reason: As a newly launched space camera with its own product page, it is likely part of a strategic long-cycle portfolio that a large established German optics firm would usually continue to support.
The modular space navigation camera appears to be a deliberate platform product, and despite some overlap risk, management would typically keep it on the market to build customer adoption.
A space situational awareness sensor suite fits a growing institutional and commercial space need, so a large experienced manufacturer would be unlikely to withdraw it so soon after launch.

Because the miniaturized space-qualified LiDAR was only mentioned rather than fully presented, it looks less commercially established and therefore has a higher withdrawal risk, but it is still likely to be retained for further market development.
